$comment: Rule manifest ai-provider-writes-v1 (ROUNDS-14-L02 stage A, #73): what pocketbase/pb_migrations/1700008810_ai_provider_writes.js changes. It sets the client create and update rules of ai_providers to null, so only the AI hook routes in pocketbase/pb_hooks/ai_custody.js write a provider row, and it reads or writes no row. The rules the collection held before are the reverse journal, which the up step records in the _params row named below and which down() puts back.

journal.holds: {collection, create, update}, with the rules the up step found
journal.locked: a rule an operator's lock left null stays null, and the record holds it as null
journal.rerun: the up step records nothing when both rules are already null, so a second forward run keeps the first record
journal.down: puts the recorded rules back and removes the record
